description: Golden-image manifest (docs/13-testing.md, section Golden images). Entries of tier 'synthetic' are generated by training/synth + `golden synth` (tools/fetch/synthetic.sh) and need no download: a CI-safe stop-gap until the CC0 tier is fetchable. Tier 'synthetic-eval' entries contain CIE CES data (CC BY-SA 4.0) and exist locally only. `settings` is the ym:Settings JSON ({} = everything Auto). The expected output hashes are kept in tools/golden/expected.json and the reference pictures under testdata/golden/refs (the golden runner, tools/golden/README.md), so `expected_hash` and `reference` stay empty here on purpose. Do not edit synthetic entries by hand: `python3 -m training.synth.make_scenes --write-manifest tools/golden/manifest.json`.

tiers.synthetic: generated, ours, CI-safe (the default set, plus the full-size scene and the rest of the light x body product with --full)
tiers.synthetic-eval: generated from CIE data (CC BY-SA 4.0); local only, never committed or cached

sets.default: written by a plain tools/fetch/synthetic.sh run (37 mosaics, 61 ARW files)
sets.full: written only with --full (the 6240 x 4160 scene and the rest of every light under every body)
